name: Seaboard Controls LLC
old_description: Seaboard Controls was started in 1981 by Philip Muro who was taught a discipline and code of ethics by his years of service in the U.S. Marines. Since Seaboard was started, he has been at the helm of his company and has built the company under the same discipline and code of ethics. Once clients utilize the services of Seaboard Controls they are quickly introduced to the highly ethical and up front business practices that has been the foundation for Seaboard Controls.
